extraction_notes: Fig. 3 is a usable typical forward-voltage curve with a linear 0 to 2.5 V voltage axis and logarithmic 0.01 to 100 A current axis; points were digitized from the plotted curve.
The datasheet lists maximum repetitive peak reverse voltage VRRM = 1000 V, maximum DC blocking voltage VDC = 1000 V, and maximum average forward rectified current IF(AV) = 1.0 A for RS1M on p. 1.

The datasheet also lists maximum non-repetitive peak forward surge current IFSM = 30.0 A, storage and junction temperature ranges of -55 to +150 degC, and typical thermal resistances RthetaJA = 75 degC/W and RthetaJL = 35 degC/W on p. 1.
The reverse-current table includes IR1 = 2.0 uA at TA = 25 degC and IR2 = 200 uA at TA = 125 degC; only the 25 degC maximum is represented in specs.reverse_current.
The typical junction capacitance is a single tabulated point at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz; no capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage plot is provided.
No breakdown voltage or breakdown-current specification is published for this rectifier, so both breakdown fields are null.
